owner.name: Anirban Das
owner.title: Founder & Managing Director
owner.quote: Welcome to our sanctuary by the sea.
owner.bio: Hospitality dedicated to luxury and warm Bengali culture.

places.name: Mandarmani Beach & Water Sports
places.description: Step directly onto the expansive golden sands for jet ski rides, parasailing, and serene morning strolls.

places.name: Tajpur Beach & Pine Groves
places.description: Famous for its dense casuarina forests and red ghost crabs scuttling along the untouched beach.

places.name: Mandarmani Mohana Seafood Market
places.description: Experience local fishermen docking their trawlers with the freshest catches of jumbo prawns, pomfret, and crabs.

places.name: Shankarpur Fishing Harbor & Beach
places.description: A charming coastal village harbor with scenic fishing boats and tranquil, uncrowded shores.

places.name: Digha Promenade & Marine Aquarium
places.description: Visit the historic seaside promenade, Asia's largest marine research aquarium, and vibrant beach markets.

places.name: Bakkhali Day Excursion
places.description: Full-day picturesque tour arranged via Ani's Tour and Travels luxury AC vehicles with experienced local drivers.

faqs.answer: Yes, free private valet parking is available on-site.

offers.description: Complimentary high tea and 15% off on 2+ nights stay during coastal monsoon seasons.

offers.title: Romantic Beach Honeymoon Package
offers.description: Includes candlelight dinner discount, celebration cake, and romantic bedroom floral decor.

testimonials.name: Rohan & Sanchari Sengupta
testimonials.comment: An absolute masterpiece of a resort! The Sunset Horizon Suite gave us direct panoramic sea views right from bed. The candlelight dinner on the beach was unforgettable.

testimonials.name: Debashis Chatterjee
testimonials.comment: Host Anirban Das personally ensured our stay was flawless. Ani's Tour and Travels provided a spotlessly clean AC car for Tajpur and Digha excursions. 10/10 service!

testimonials.name: Dr. Ananya Roy
testimonials.comment: The infinity swimming pool overlooking the ocean is world-class. Seafood at The Bay Breeze was fresh and mouth-watering. Best luxury stay in Mandarmani.

anisTours.headline: Your Trusted Travel Partner in Bengal
anisTours.description: Explore Mandarmani, Tajpur, Shankarpur, and Digha with our private fleet of clean AC cars, expert local chauffeurs, and 24/7 dedicated assistance.

welcomeMessage.en:
Welcome to Coastal View, Managed By Ani's! 🌊
How may I assist your Mandarmani holiday today?
welcomeMessage.bn:
কোস্টাল ভিউ, ম্যানেজড বাই অনি'স-এ আপনাকে স্বাগতম! 🌊
মন্দারমণিতে আপনার ছুটির জন্য আমি কীভাবে সাহায্য করতে পারি?
welcomeMessage.hi:
कोस्टल व्यू, मैनेज्ड बाय अनीज़ में आपका स्वागत है! 🌊
मंदारमणि में आपकी छुट्टियों के लिए मैं क्या मदद कर सकता हूँ?

offlineMessage.en: Our concierge desk is currently operating with high volume. Please leave your contact number and Anirban Das or our front desk will call you promptly.
offlineMessage.bn: আমাদের ফ্রন্ট ডেস্ক বর্তমানে ব্যস্ত আছে। অনুগ্রহ করে আপনার ফোন নম্বর দিন, অনির্বাণ দাস বা আমাদের প্রতিনিধি দ্রুত কল করবেন।
offlineMessage.hi: हमारा डेस्क इस समय व्यस्त है। कृपया अपना संपर्क नंबर साझा करें, हमारी टीम जल्द ही आपसे संपर्क करेगी।

botSettings.toneInstructions: Emphasize sea-view balconies and authentic fresh catch.

fallbackMessage.en: I didn't understand that query. Please select from the options below or contact our front desk directly.
fallbackMessage.bn: আমি আপনার প্রশ্নটি ঠিক বুঝতে পারিনি। দয়া করে নিচের বিকল্পগুলো নির্বাচন করুন বা আমাদের ফ্রন্ট ডেস্কে সরাসরি কল করুন।
fallbackMessage.hi: मैं आपका प्रश्न समझ नहीं पाया। कृपया नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से चुनें या हमारे फ्रंट डेस्क से सीधे संपर्क करें।
